name: WebWerk Stickers & Overlays
author: Mohammad Loutfi

sections.description:
WebWerk Stickers & Overlays adds attention-grabbing elements to your website – floating stickers, a full-width notification bar, and a popup overlay – to highlight offers, announcements or calls to action without touching a line of code.

Unlike a basic sticker plugin, the free version already covers what most site owners actually need:

Stickers your way

  • Up to 3 stickers, in 5 shapes (rectangle, rounded, pill, circle, corner ribbon) or as a full-width top/bottom bar
  • 6 animations plus fade/slide entrance effects, an optional icon, and full color/text control
  • Device, page, URL, date, time and weekday targeting – evaluated in the visitor’s browser, so a full-page cache (WP Rocket, LiteSpeed, Cloudflare, …) never freezes the wrong sticker for everyone
  • Optional dismiss (×) button, remembered per visitor for a session, a day, or permanently

A popup overlay that converts

  • Trigger it by time delay, exit intent, or scroll position
  • Optional countdown timer, and a reappearance rule (always / once / per session / per day) so it doesn’t nag repeat visitors
  • Fully keyboard accessible: focus trap, Esc to close, proper ARIA labels for screen readers – not an afterthought

Know what’s working

  • Built-in view/click statistics with a per-day chart, a per-sticker breakdown, a bot filter, rate limiting, and CSV export – no external analytics account required
  • Optional Google Analytics 4 event on click, if you already use GA4

Built for real workflows

  • A “Preview” mode shows you enabled stickers and the overlay exactly as configured, regardless of their rules – so you can check your design without waiting for a schedule or trigger to fire
  • Settings import/export as JSON, to move a configuration between sites
  • Gutenberg block and shortcode for placing a sticker manually inside content
  • A one-click option to keep stickers and the overlay off your privacy policy / imprint page

It’s lightweight, translation-ready, and works with any theme.

Features

  • Up to 3 stickers, 5 shapes (rectangle, rounded, pill, circle, corner ribbon) or a full-width top/bottom bar
  • Optional icon next to the sticker text
  • 6 animations plus fade/slide entrance effects, with reduced-motion support
  • Custom colors and text
  • Multiple positions (top/bottom, left/right)
  • Device targeting (desktop/mobile, with an adjustable breakpoint) and scheduling evaluated in the visitor’s browser, so full-page caches stay accurate
  • Page and URL rules (exact match or wildcard prefix)
  • Date, time and weekday scheduling
  • Optional dismiss (×) button per sticker, remembered per visitor
  • One-click option to hide stickers/overlay on the privacy policy / imprint page
  • Overlay with time delay, exit-intent or scroll-position triggers, configurable reappearance frequency, and an optional countdown timer
  • Accessible overlay dialog (keyboard focus trap, Esc to close, screen-reader labels)
  • Gutenberg block and shortcode for manual placement
  • “Preview” mode to see stickers/overlay live, regardless of their rules, visible only to you
  • Built-in view/click statistics (totals, per-day chart, per-sticker breakdown) with a bot filter, rate limiting and CSV export
  • Optional Google Analytics 4 event tracking
  • Settings import/export (JSON)

Pro Features

Looking for advanced marketing and conversion features?

WebWerk Stickers & Overlays Pro extends the free version with additional premium elements, animations, and advanced customization options for professional websites and online shops.

Pro version features include:

  • Image stickers
  • Mascots and animated elements
  • Floating banners
  • Additional overlay styles
  • Advanced animations and motion effects
  • More placement options
  • Advanced scheduling rules
  • Extended targeting options
  • Enhanced statistics
  • Priority support

Learn more about the Pro version:
https://www.webwerk-muenster.de/webwerk-stickers-overlays/

The free version available on WordPress.org remains fully functional and does not require a license key.

Additional Extensions

WebWerk Stickers & Overlays is fully functional as provided on WordPress.org.

Optional separate extensions may add additional element types or design options.

All functionality included in this WordPress.org version is available without a license key, payment, trial period, or external service.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to WebWerk Stickers in the admin menu
  4. Create your first sticker
sections.faq:
Does this plugin affect performance?

No, the plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance.

Can I control where stickers appear?

Yes, you can define page rules, URLs, devices, and schedules.

Is the free version fully functional?

Yes, the free version includes all functionality described in this listing.

Is there a Pro version available?

Yes, an optional Pro version with additional advanced features is available separately.

More information:
https://www.webwerk-muenster.de/webwerk-stickers-overlays/
sections.changelog:
0.7.1

  • Fix: device/date/time/weekday rules are evaluated server-side again for any sticker type other than the built-in text sticker (relevant when the separate Pro add-on is active), after the 0.6.0 cache-safety rework had switched that evaluation to a client-side pass that only covers the built-in sticker’s own markup

0.7.0

  • New: full-width notification bar as an additional sticker placement (top or bottom), alongside the existing floating badge
  • New: optional icon (from the built-in Dashicons set) next to the sticker text
  • New: countdown timer in the overlay, with a choice of what happens at zero
  • New: “Preview” mode – see enabled stickers and the overlay on the live site regardless of their rules, visible only to you
  • New: per-sticker view/click breakdown table and CSV export on the Statistics tab
  • New: adjustable mobile breakpoint, and a one-click option to hide stickers/overlay on the privacy policy / imprint page
  • Improvement: the Statistics tab now shows the per-sticker data the backend was already computing

0.6.0

  • Fix: sticker device/date/time/weekday visibility is now evaluated in the browser instead of on the server, so full-page caches no longer freeze the wrong visibility state for all visitors
  • Fix: URL rules now match the exact path or a * wildcard prefix instead of a loose substring, avoiding false matches like /shop matching /shop-alt
  • Fix: view/click tracking now filters obvious bots and rate-limits requests per visitor
  • New: 2 additional shapes (circle, corner ribbon) and 2 additional animations (wobble, shine)
  • New: optional fade/slide entrance animation for stickers; all animations respect the visitor’s reduced-motion preference
  • New: optional dismiss (×) button per sticker with per-session or permanent memory
  • New: overlay trigger options (time delay, exit intent, scroll position) and a reappearance frequency setting (always / once / per session / per day)
  • New: the overlay dialog is keyboard accessible (focus trap, Esc closes it, ARIA labels for screen readers)
  • New: Gutenberg block for placing a sticker inline, alongside the existing shortcode
  • New: optional Google Analytics 4 click event
  • New: settings import/export as JSON, and a quick “duplicate sticker” action
  • Improvement: frontend script no longer depends on jQuery
  • Improvement: removed unused/duplicated code in the statistics and admin classes

0.5.0

  • Initial release
  • Sticker and overlay system
